# Mercafé

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Official online store of the 3 Corações group for coffee. Sells coffee capsules, coffee machines, ground and whole-bean coffees, cappuccinos, accessories and offers a subscription. Its delivery policy says deliveries cover all of Brazil and that delivery abroad and to PO boxes is not offered.

*ES:* Tienda online oficial del grupo 3 Corações para café. Vende cápsulas de café, máquinas de café, cafés molidos y en grano, cappuccinos y accesorios, y ofrece suscripción. Su política de entrega indica que las entregas cubren todo Brasil y que no se realizan entregas al exterior ni a casillas postales.
